major_findings: P10 is a multi-scope subsystem: household/property, service institution, relocation, family-caused property relations, contract/dispute, environmental sensitivity and timing must remain typed separately.
Property ownership/preservation is not equivalent to speculative real-estate profit; the chapter explicitly warns that speculative profit is generally not determined by P10 alone.
TP01-036 restores the Ziwei-Tanlang exception/re-entry scope for the fire-event candidate.
TP01-044/045 preserve the source's 大限流年 scope in a sidecar instead of silently narrowing it to the legacy primary DECADE field.
TP01-048 restores the omitted interaction with 大限流煞 and the explicit Chang/Qu palace alternatives.
TP01-084 restores distinct 火星同度 / 铃星会 / 煞耗 / 流煞冲会 structure.
OCR-uncertain source surfaces in TP01-017 and TP01-037 are preserved as uncertainty, not silently corrected.
